about: The /ask eval set (M3 slice 4). Every case is run by services/ai/scripts/run_eval.py.

tiers: 'keyless' cases run on every PR against the fixture embedder; 'keyed' cases run only when an OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret is present. The fixture ranks by shared words, so paraphrases and out-of-domain refusals are keyed-only: the relevance floor abstains on the fixture by design, and asserting a refusal there would assert something that cannot happen.
holdings: 'demo' supplies the fixed portfolio in run_eval.py; 'none' supplies nothing.

expect: {slugs: [...]} = answered, and at least one listed concept appears in the citations. {answer_source: 'computed'} = answered by arithmetic. {refused: reason} = declined for exactly that reason.

Bias, stated rather than hidden: these were written by the session that also wrote the corpus and the thresholds, so the author had seen every document. The mitigation is below - no case may repeat a question the thresholds were fitted to - and it is a mitigation, not a cure. Questions written by someone who has never read the corpus would be worth more than any number of these.
expect {hedged: true} = answered, graded weak, and the reply text opens with the weak-match caveat (WEAK_MATCH_PREFIX) rather than merely carrying a flag.

out_of_domain: true marks a case whose question the corpus does not cover even though its expected handling is not a refusal (see adjacent-gold). The threshold report counts it as out-of-domain regardless: what a case IS must not change because what we DO about it changed, or the separation figure improves by relabelling.

cases.note: Finance vocabulary with no corpus answer - the hardest case. Originally expected a refusal; the first keyed run found it scores 0.2502 against a legitimate question's 0.2498, so no threshold separates them. Decided 2026-09-24: at that boundary the honest reply is a hedged closest match, not a refusal chosen by a coin flip. This expectation changed because the spec changed, and it says so here rather than quietly turning green.
